title: Precast
intro: Ethios delivers premium precast construction solutions, including panels, beams, slabs, walls, and other structural elements, manufactured under controlled factory conditions for superior strength, consistency, and durability. Designed for residential, commercial, and industrial projects, these solutions enable faster, more efficient on-site installation, reduce material wastage, and ensure long-lasting, high-performance results for modern construction.

products.name: Fly Ash Brick
products.description: AAC blocks made from fly ash offer superior compressive strength, thermal insulation, and excellent soundproofing for modern construction. These lightweight, eco-friendly blocks reduce structural load, speed up wall construction, and cut down mortar and energy costs by up to 30%. Perfect choice for sustainable and efficient masonry work.

products.name: Hydraulic Mould 450x300x150 mm
products.description: Hydraulic Mould Kerb Stone (400x300x150mm) is a precision-engineered concrete edging block manufactured using advanced hydraulic press technology for superior strength and finish. Ideal for urban roads, pavements, and landscaping, it offers excellent durability, dimensional accuracy, and high impact resistance for long-lasting performance.

products.name: Mould - Kerb Stone 450x300x150 mm
products.description: Mould Kerb Stone (400x300x150mm) is a robust and aesthetically finished concrete edging block crafted through precision moulding techniques. Ideal for pathways, dividers, and landscaping borders, it offers excellent strength, uniform shape, and long-lasting durability for both residential and commercial infrastructure projects.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x100mm
products.description: Fly Ash AAC Block (600x200x100mm) is a lightweight, eco-friendly masonry unit ideal for partition walls and internal non-load-bearing structures. Made from recycled fly ash, it offers excellent thermal insulation, soundproofing, and fire resistance. Perfect for fast, sustainable, and energy-efficient construction.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x120mm
products.description: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x120mm is a precast construction solution from Ethios offering strength, faster installation, and long-lasting performance. Contact our technical team for specifications and application guidance.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x150mm
products.description: Fly Ash AAC Block (600x200x150mm) is a lightweight, eco-friendly building material ideal for external and internal wall construction. Engineered for strength and insulation, it reduces dead load, improves energy efficiency, and speeds up installation. Perfect for sustainable and cost-effective construction projects.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x200mm
products.description: Fly Ash AAC Block (600x200x200mm) is a high-strength, lightweight masonry block ideal for load-bearing and non-load-bearing walls. Made from eco-friendly fly ash, it offers excellent thermal insulation, fire resistance, and soundproofing. Best suited for energy-efficient, durable, and faster construction across all building types.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x225mm
products.description: Fly Ash AAC Block (600x200x225mm) is a durable, lightweight construction block designed for high-strength wall applications. Manufactured using eco-friendly fly ash, it ensures superior thermal insulation, acoustic performance, and fire resistance. Ideal for fast, sustainable, and cost-effective construction in residential and commercial projects.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block 600x200x125mm
products.description: Fly Ash AAC Block (600x200x125mm) is a high-performance, lightweight block designed for internal and external wall applications. Manufactured using eco-friendly fly ash, it provides superior thermal insulation, fire resistance, and soundproofing. Ideal for faster construction with reduced dead load and enhanced energy efficiency.

products.name: Fly Ash AAC Block Scrap - Tukda
products.description: Fly Ash Block Scrap – Tukda is a cost-effective, eco-friendly material ideal for backfilling, road sub-base layering, leveling, and non-structural applications. Made from recycled AAC block pieces, it offers lightweight, easy handling, and sustainable disposal of construction waste. Perfect for eco-conscious site development and groundwork.

products.name: Fuji U Shape Drain-900x900 (T25)
products.description: FUJI U-Shape Drain (900x900mm – T-25) is a robust precast RCC drainage channel engineered for heavy-duty applications, supporting up to 5-tonne wheel loads. Manufactured with high-performance self-compacting concrete as per JIS standards, it is ideal for highways, industrial zones, and large infrastructure projects requiring efficient stormwater or cable duct solutions.

products.name: Fuji U Shape Drain Lid- 900mm (T-25)
products.description: FUJI U-Shape Drain (900x900mm – T-25) is a robust precast RCC drainage channel engineered for heavy-duty applications, supporting up to 5-tonne wheel loads. Manufactured with high-performance self-compacting concrete as per JIS standards, it is ideal for highways, industrial zones, and large infrastructure projects requiring efficient stormwater or cable duct solutions.

products.name: Fuji U Shape Drain Lid- 1200mm (T-25)
products.description: FUJI U-Shape Drain Lid (1200mm – T-25) is a high-strength precast concrete cover designed to withstand up to 5-tonne wheel loads. Manufactured using self-compacting RCC as per Japanese Industrial Standards (JIS), it provides secure, durable, and maintenance-friendly protection for U-drains in highways, industrial areas, and utility corridors.

products.name: Fuji FT Flume - 900X900x2000
products.description: FUJI FT Flume (900x900x2000mm) is a high-performance precast RCC open channel system ideal for efficient water conveyance in irrigation, stormwater, and utility duct applications. Manufactured with self-compacting concrete as per Japanese Industrial Standards (JIS), it ensures superior durability, quick installation, and minimal maintenance in large-scale infrastructure projects.

products.name: Paver Rubber Mould (200x200mm)
products.description: Paver Rubber Mould (200x200mm) is a high-quality, durable mould designed for producing precision-finished concrete paver blocks. Made from premium-grade rubber, it ensures easy demoulding, long mould life, and consistent shapes. Ideal for manufacturing designer pavers used in walkways, driveways, and landscaping projects.

products.name: Paver Block - Damru Shape 60mm – Green
products.description: Paver Block – Damru Shape 60mm (Green) is an interlocking, heavy-duty concrete paver ideal for walkways, parking zones, and landscaped pathways. Its unique Damru design ensures superior load distribution, anti-skid performance, and aesthetic appeal. UV-stable green color adds vibrancy and durability to outdoor surfaces.
